new_claim.statement: For original-coordinate blocks {Z},I,J,W with d=A_ZZ nonzero, A[Z,J]=0, and exact-rank-two B=A[I,J] of singular-value product Delta, if the 2D SVD projection densities have caps M_L,M_R then phi_Q is L1 and ||p_Q||_infinity <= [16/6^(3/4)](M_LM_R)^(3/8)|d|^(-1/4)Delta^(-3/8). For arbitrary cap-one product banks M_L,M_R<=2, giving prefactor <7.019062. The density is continuous on this branch.

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality_used: Its integral |phi_Q|^2 <=6*pi*2^(2/3)|det D|^(-1/3) gives a low-frequency A_0 T^(1/2) bound; coupled to the new H T^(-1/3) tail this yields ||p_Q||_infinity <=5*2^(11/15)*3^(-2/5)|det D|^(-1/15)(M_LM_R)^(3/10)|d|^(-1/5)Delta^(-3/10).

fourier_status: A genuine L1 characteristic-function estimate is proved on the new one-sided-square plus exact-rank-two cross branch. No exact-target counterexample to target-wide unweighted L1 characteristic-function control was established; the full uniform criterion remains open.
unresolved_implication: Remove the explicit A[Z,J]=0 one-sided isolation by a two-sided square/rank-two vector-valued estimate, or derive a valid product-preserving structural alternative routing every s_3(A)>=1 matrix into this or another paid branch.
next_step: Attack the two-sided square/rank-two Fourier amplitude before any bank conditioning; keep the scalar-square L3 time resource coupled to both bank variables rather than taking a worst fiber.
